limitations: The entrance link, front doors, internal glazing, stair openings and structural walls stay in place.
Two 320 mm-deep joinery legs wrap the retained wall corner; coats hang end-on in two bays.
The shoe bench sits below the retained gym glazing. The route remains clear with someone seated or choosing a coat.
The original stair geometry and radiator remain; the stair receives oak treads, ivory risers and simple bronze guarding.
The normal study views retain the double-height entrance. The cutaway removes the upper storeys only for ground-floor review.
